research_digest_consumption.reason: Every eligible digest entry already had a terminal disposition.

hypothesis_candidates.title: Pre-redemption SPAC trust-claim discount convergence
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: contractual cash-claim discount converges through valid redemption and trust cash release
hypothesis_candidates.baseline: cash or the displaced cash-feasible core candidate
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: admit only a PIT issuer whose executable ask is below the filing-vintage net claim by an all-in safety margin and whose broker deadline is verified
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: cash, SPY, QQQ and exact displaced core candidate
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: fewer than 20 eligible settlements, unreliable broker submission, or non-positive replacement value after all costs/carry/tails

hypothesis_candidates.title: Fungible ADR versus home-share parity convergence
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: same legal claim converges across venues outside a fully measured FX/conversion/cost band
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: paired cheap-claim entry and rich-claim hedge only on synchronized executable quotes and bound conversion terms
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: cash, unhedged cheap leg and exact displaced core candidate
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: fewer than 20 after-cost settlements or inability to execute both legs and FX/borrow hedge

hypothesis_candidates.title: Assignment-aware executable put-call parity residual
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: replication residual converges or settles after all American-option and execution frictions
hypothesis_candidates.baseline: cash on equal capital and margin
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: conversion or reversal only on simultaneous executable quotes with bound carry, dividend, borrow and assignment reserves
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: cash on equal margin plus exact displaced core candidate
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: fewer than 30 independently executable settlements or non-positive assignment-aware PnL after margin and tail reserves

panel_result.interpretation: The direct zero-row/source/mapping blockers are load-bearing. Component-source mismatches and several machine D3 neighbors are non-load-bearing assembly or classification defects.
